name: Infrastructure as Code & Automation
description: Safe Terraform change via Atmos: registry, plan, policy, scan, cost, approval, GitLab merge request, state, drift, rollback.

capabilities.name: Terraform module registry
capabilities.summary: 12 components with parsed inputs, outputs, version and status.

capabilities.name: Version-controlled infrastructure templates
capabilities.summary: Stacks are generated YAML committed to GitLab through merge requests (local files without GitLab).

capabilities.name: Automated plan generation
capabilities.summary: Every change runs atmos validate + describe. A real terraform plan runs in GitLab CI or in live mode.

capabilities.name: Plan review
capabilities.summary: Reviewers see the YAML diff, policy findings, cost delta and validation output before approving.

capabilities.name: Policy validation
capabilities.summary: 16 policy-as-code rules (deny blocks, warn forces human approval), mapped to CIS/NIST/ISO/SOC 2.

capabilities.name: Security scanning
capabilities.summary: Built-in rules always run; Checkov or Trivy run automatically when installed on the host or CI image.

capabilities.name: Cost estimation
capabilities.summary: Monthly estimate from list prices per component; usage-based items listed as notes.

capabilities.name: Deployment orchestration
capabilities.summary: One open merge request per environment, queue, ordered operations, GitLab CI plan/apply, manual gate for production.

capabilities.name: State management
capabilities.summary: S3 remote state per stack and component, generated by Atmos.

capabilities.name: State locking
capabilities.summary: S3 native lock files (Terraform >= 1.10) plus a CI resource group.

capabilities.name: Drift detection
capabilities.summary: terraform plan -detailed-exitcode per component; needs live mode and credentials.

capabilities.name: Rollback and recovery
capabilities.summary: Roll an environment back to any stack version as a new reviewed change; closed MRs restore the previous stack.

capabilities.name: Module versioning and deprecation
capabilities.summary: Registry version and deprecated status are enforced on new changes; pinning multiple versions is not built yet.
